sign: Three terraces, one well, too many ladders.

lines: Keeper Ysolde: Sit under the willow and drink from the pool. It mends tired Spirlings.
Trader Ebbe: Brook-cooled tonics, fresh every day.
trader.action: shop tonic strong_tonic remedy dry_towel cooling_gel kin_charm revival_leaf

lines: Ropemaker Nell: The old wells hereabouts go deep. You'll want a ladder you can leave behind.
Ropemaker Nell: Tie it where you see a chalk mark. It holds.
Ropemaker Nell: Every knot I tie has a name. That one was 'Patience'.

elder: Old Bertil: We heard the Rift from down here. Like a bell cracking.
kid: Wren-kid: I counted the ladder rungs. All of them. Two hundred and six!

lines: Driver Fenna: Valley Coach, Wrenhollow stop. Climb in, the seats are dry.
